messages.content: Alice: Just arrived at the hotel! I paid the deposit: €150 for all three of us.
Bob: Great location! The view from our room is amazing.
Charlie: I'm starving. Let's find some lunch soon.
Alice: I got our train tickets yesterday: €210 total for all three.
Bob: The weather forecast looks perfect for hiking tomorrow!
Charlie: Lunch at the café was €45. Split between Bob and me.
Alice: Museum entrance fees: €75 total for all of us.
Bob: This gelato is incredible! I paid €12 for three cones.
Charlie: How about dinner at that Italian place tonight?
Alice: Groceries for breakfast: €36. Shared equally.
Bob: Taxi to the hiking trail: €27. Split three ways.
Charlie: I bought snacks for the hike: €24. Alice and Bob owe me.
Alice: The hotel refunded €30 for the early check-in, for Charlie and me.
Bob: Lunch on the mountain: €51. All three of us.
Charlie: Cable car tickets down: €42 total. Shared payment.
Alice: Dinner at the Italian restaurant: €120. Split equally.
Bob: Wine with dinner: €36. Charlie and I shared this.
Charlie: Morning coffee run: €15 for three coffees.
Alice: Boat tour tickets: €90. Everyone pays their share.
Bob: The sunset from the boat was breathtaking!
Charlie: Snacks on the boat: €21. Split between Alice and me.
Alice: I got a €18 refund on the boat tickets for Bob and Charlie.
Bob: Dinner tonight: €87. Three-way split.
Charlie: Drinks after dinner: €45. Alice and Bob owe me.
Alice: Groceries for picnic: €33. Shared equally.
Bob: Beach umbrella rental: €24. All three of us.
Charlie: Ice creams: €18. Split three ways.
Alice: The museum gift shop refund: €12 for me and Charlie.
Bob: Lunch at the beach café: €69. Everyone.
Charlie: Taxi back to hotel: €30. Shared payment.
Alice: Dinner reservation made for tonight at 7 PM.
Bob: I paid for the cooking class: €120 total for all three.
Charlie: Ingredients for class: €36. Split between Bob and me.
Alice: Wine tasting tickets: €75. Three-way split.
Bob: The cheese plate was amazing at the tasting!
Charlie: Additional wine bottles: €42. Alice and I shared.
Alice: Got €15 refund on wine tasting for Bob and Charlie.
Bob: Dinner tonight: €96. All three.
Charlie: Late night snacks: €27. Split equally.
Alice: Breakfast buffet: €45. Shared payment.
Bob: Train tickets for day trip: €78. Everyone pays.
Charlie: Lunch in the village: €54. Three-way split.
Alice: Souvenirs: €60. Bob and Charlie owe me.
Bob: The local market was fantastic today!
Charlie: Taxi back from village: €36. All three.
Alice: Got €21 refund on souvenirs for Bob only.
Bob: Dinner reservation at 8 PM tonight.
Charlie: I paid for tonight's dinner: €135. Split equally.
Alice: Cocktails after dinner: €48. Shared between me and Bob.
Bob: Late night pizza: €30. Charlie and I split this.
